note: A net with two continuous drivers - two devices sharing a bus. CURRENTLY FAILS, DELIBERATELY, on hif-backend#88: the net regenerates as one `output reg` written by two always blocks, so the last process to run wins and a bus driven by exactly one device reads zzzz. Behavioral because the regenerated module keeps the same ports and the same two expressions and reparses cleanly; what it lost is that bus was a net, which no parse can check. replicated_z_literal covers one driver releasing a pin and passes, and the VHDL-sourced vhdl_shared_bus passes, so the gap is specific to the Verilog multi-driver path.
